inclusions.text: Meet at Cairo International and transfer to the Mena House
inclusions.source: You are met at Cairo International and transferred directly to the Mena House.

inclusions.text: An Egyptologist for the Cairo and Alexandria touring days

inclusions.text: Transfer to Cairo International on departure
inclusions.source: The departure morning belongs to the hotel: late breakfast on the terrace, a final walk to the plateau base in the morning light — the Pyramids at their best, before the day's heat builds — and an unhurried transfer to Cairo International.

itinerary.title: Arrival and transfer to the Mena House
itinerary.source: Check-in, the grounds, the view from your room — that is the programme on the first day, and it is sufficient.

itinerary.title: Giza, the Egyptian Museum and the Citadel
itinerary.source: A second day turns to the monuments on the doorstep.

itinerary.title: Alexandria: the Mediterranean day
itinerary.source: A third day leaves Cairo entirely and goes north.
